title: Younger
summary: YOUNGER, adjective comparative Yunger. Not so old as another. A person of ninety years old is younger than one of a hundred, though certainly not a young man, nor in the first part of life.

inlines.v: YOUNGER, adjective comparative Yunger. Not so old as another. A person of ninety years old is younger than one of a hundred, though certainly not a young man, nor in the first part of life.
